definitions.explanation: Designed for or meant to be used by a single person, often describing portions, rooms, or equipment.

examples.japanese: {一人用|ひとりよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦テント→テント：03859_tento⟧。
{一人用|ひとりよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}した→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧。
examples.english: I ordered a single-serving hot pot set.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ソファ→ソファ：04485_sofa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一人用|ひとりよう}だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{狭|せま}い→狭い：00750_semai⟧。
examples.english: This sofa is for one person, so it's small.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧ (one person) + ⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧ (for use). Functions as a no-adjective: {一人用|ひとりよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜. Indicates something is sized, portioned, or designed for a single person.

COMMON ITEMS DESCRIBED:
- {一人用|ひとりよう}⟦テント→テント：03859_tento⟧ (single-person tent)
- {一人用|ひとりよう}⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧ (single-serving hot pot)
- {一人用|ひとりよう}こたつ (single-person kotatsu)
- {一人用|ひとりよう}⟦ソファ→ソファ：04485_sofa⟧ (single-seat sofa)
- {一人用|ひとりよう}⟦おせち→おせち：09649_osechi⟧ (individual osechi set)

COMMON PATTERNS:
The 〜⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧ (for ~ use) suffix is productive:
- {二人用|ふたりよう}: for two people
- {三人用|さんにんよう}: for three people
- {家族用|かぞくよう}: for family use
- {子供用|こどもよう}: for children
- ⟦{業務用|ぎょうむよう}→業務用：13148_gyoumuyou⟧: for business/commercial use
